File contract: Write final class Solution in Solution.java with the static method shown; java.util types may be imported.

Behavior: The three arrays encode events with strictly increasing sequence numbers. Reject unequal lengths, non-increasing sequence numbers, or empty keys. Keep only the final event for each key and return its value, ordered by the final events' positions; empty input succeeds.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> compactOrderedEvents(List<Integer>seq,List<String>keys,List<Integer>values){if(seq.size()!=keys.size()||seq.size()!=values.size())return null;var last=new HashMap<String,Integer>();for(int i=0;i<seq.size();i++){if(i>0&&seq.get(i)<=seq.get(i-1)||keys.get(i).isEmpty())return null;last.put(keys.get(i),i);}var out=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int i=0;i<keys.size();i++)if(last.get(keys.get(i))==i)out.add(values.get(i));return out;}}
